stem.text: A cell of electromotive force (e.m.f.) $E$ and internal resistance $r$ is connected in series with a switch S and an external resistor of resistance $R$.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram: a cell with its internal resistance inside a dashed outline, with the ends of the outline labelled P and Q. Outside the outline, a switch labelled S and an external resistor labelled R are connected in series. Printed labels: E, r, R, S, P, Q.

stem.text: The potential difference (p.d.) between P and Q is $V$.
Which statement is correct when S is changed from open to closed?

A.text: $V$ increases because there is a p.d. across $R$.

B.text: $V$ decreases because there is a p.d. across $r$.

C.text: $V$ remains the same because the decrease of p.d. across $r$ is balanced by the increase of p.d. across $R$.

D.text: $V$ remains the same because the sum of the p.d.s across $r$ and $R$ is still equal to $E$.
